prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1242; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss for a left-turn collision at an intersection. Insured reports the other vehicle struck the rear quarter panel as the insured completed a left turn on a green arrow. Police report requested. Both drivers stated no injuries at scene.

Entry 2: Claimant's representation letter received. Counsel has requested that all communications be directed to their office. Claimant now reports lower back strain following the collision and has been advised to seek medical evaluation. Medical authorization forms sent to counsel.

Entry 3: Reviewed scene photographs and damage estimate. Impact area consistent with a left-turn collision. Rear quarter panel and passenger door damage noted on claimant vehicle. Liability appears to be disputed by counsel, who contends the insured failed to yield to oncoming traffic. Traffic signal timing records requested from the municipality.

Entry 4: Received treating physician's initial report. Diagnosis is lumbar strain with physical therapy recommended. Counsel has submitted a demand package and requested a review of the injury claim. Medical records reviewed. Injury appears soft tissue in nature, consistent with the mechanism of impact described in the police report.

Entry 5: Spoke with defense counsel regarding liability position. Signal timing data obtained, showing the insured's green arrow phase was active at the time of impact. Liability assessment updated to favor the insured, subject to review of witness statement. Bodily injury reserve reviewed and adjusted. File remains open pending completion of treatment and final demand evaluation.
